title: Process Search
description: config.ini [Process Search] section (ProcessSearchConfig). Keys, defaults, and allowed values.

minimization_offset.description:
This is the distance images bracketing the saddle are displaced.

After a saddle is found, images are placed on either side of the saddle
along the mode and minimized to ensure that the saddle is connected to the
original minimum and to locate the product state.
This defaults to being the same as
:any:`eon.schema.OptimizerConfig.max_move`

minimize_first.description: Every time a process search is run by a client the reactant will be minimized first before doing any saddle searches.

known_saddles.description:
Stop a min-mode climb that reaches a saddle the state already has.

The server sends each min-mode process search the saddles found from
its state: the processes, and the saddles of searches that converged
but failed afterwards (not connected, bad prefactor, barrier out of
window, unconverged minima, failed prefactor, negative barrier). A
climb point with negative curvature that matches one of them in energy
and structure, under the structure comparison, ends the search with
status 23 before the endpoint minimizations. The server records it as a
repeat of that process or as the same failed saddle again. Both the
server and the client read the key; with it false the server sends no
list and the client ignores one.
